request.spec:
The sheet has a fiscal year start month (settings, 1 to 12, 1 unless set, not dated;
SETTING_CHANGED key=fiscal-start-month value=<month>; anything else is refused). A fiscal year is
named FY<yyyy> by the calendar year its first day falls in; show on each period the fiscal year its
from-date falls in. A year entry and a button generate that fiscal year's twelve monthly periods
exactly as the period generator does; show how many were made.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
The sheet has a fiscal year start month (settings, 1 to 12, 1 unless set, not dated;
SETTING_CHANGED key=fiscal-start-month value=<month>; anything else is refused). A fiscal year is
named FY<yyyy> by the calendar year its first day falls in; show on each period the fiscal year its
from-date falls in. A year entry and a button generate that fiscal year's twelve monthly periods
exactly as the period generator does; show how many were made.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The fiscal year change is in, and all 4 acceptance tests pass with `bin/e2e`.

**Setting**
- The sheet now stores a fiscal year start month. A new migration, `V77__sheet_fiscal_start_month.sql`, adds it as a non-null column that defaults to 1.
- A new endpoint, `PUT /api/sheets/{id}/settings/fiscal-start-month`, saves it. The server only accepts whole numbers from 1 to 12, so `13` or `x` are refused, nothing is written and the settings error appears. The settings form checks this as well.
- Each change writes `SETTING_CHANGED sheet=<id> by=<user> key=fiscal-start-month value=<month>` to the audit file.
- The setting is not dated. It is copied when a sheet is cloned and included in history snapshots; snapshots taken before this change read it as 1.

**Fiscal year on each period**
- Each period row shows `FY<yyyy>`, worked out from its from-date and the start month. With a start month of 4, a period starting in March 2027 shows FY2026.
- The front end works this out from the sheet's current setting, so changing the start month updates the labels immediately.

**Generating a fiscal year**
- The periods panel has a new year box and button. They call a new endpoint, `POST /periods/generate-fy`, which runs the existing monthly generator from the first of the start month for twelve months.
- Months that clash with an existing period's name or dates are skipped the same way the generator skips them. In the test's sheet, April 2026 is already covered by P2, so the first press makes 11 periods and the second makes 0. The count shows in the same `period-generated` element as the normal generator.
- A year that isn't four digits is refused with the generate error.
